chapter: Three Deuces and 52nd Street with Tatum
title: Soft Winds and other Christian tunes
summary: He remembers only Soft Winds from the titles and explains that Christian played what he would have played.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: Do you remember doing these tunes? If I had you, Japanese Sandman, Soft Winds.

Soft winds is the only one I could remember. Like I said, I liked all of Charlie Christian's things. Because he played what I would play. He was just thinking ahead of me. I'd say 'Gee, whiz, man. That's what I was going to play.' ... But I'm probably just talking to hear myself talk. He was phenomenal man. I just had the same instinct to do that, because I never copied him riff for riff, you might say, except on certain tunes...
